test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

My sister prefers tea than coffee in the afternoon after lunch.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'tea than coffee'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'tea to coffee'** should be used instead of &
